tools.description:
Search arXiv preprints directly (freshest source for new preprints).

Free text becomes an all-fields AND query; arXiv field syntax passes
through unchanged (ti:, au:, abs:, cat:, e.g. `ti:lattice AND au:Peikert`).
`category` limits results to one arXiv category such as cs.CR or quant-ph.
Year filters use the submission date. `sort`: relevance or newest.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_arxiv_search

tools.description:
Search Crossref, the registry of DOIs for journals, proceedings, and books.

Useful for resolving a half-remembered citation to its DOI and publisher
record. Filters: publication year range and author.
`sort`: relevance, cited, or newest.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_crossref_search

tools.description:
Search DBLP, the curated computer-science bibliography, newest first.

Every keyword must appear in the title ("quoted phrases" stay together).
`author` is a case-insensitive substring of the DBLP author name.
`venue` accepts CRYPTO, EUROCRYPT, ASIACRYPT, CHES/TCHES, FSE/ToSC, JoC,
PKC, TCC, CT-RSA, PQCrypto, SAC, COSADE, CARDIS, DCC, CiC, ePrint, CCS, S&P,
USENIX Security, NDSS, EuroS&P, ACNS, ESORICS, CSF, TIFS, TDSC, CoRR, or a
DBLP stream key such as conf/crypto or journals/tches; other text
matches a substring of DBLP's venue label. At least one of keywords,
author, or venue is required. `peer_reviewed_only` drops arXiv/ePrint
preprint records. Queries take a few seconds.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_dblp_search

tools.description:
Search OpenAlex, an open index of ~250M works with abstracts and citations.

Filters: publication year range, author name, and open access only.
`sort`: relevance (default), cited (most cited first), or newest.
Results carry OpenAlex IDs (W...) for paper_details and paper_citations,
and link a legal open-access PDF when one is known.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_openalex_search

tools.description:
List papers that cite a paper, or the papers it references (OpenAlex).

`direction`: cited_by (later work citing it) or references (work it
cites). `identifier`: DOI, arXiv ID, OpenAlex work ID, or Semantic
Scholar ID. `sort`: cited (most cited first), newest, or relevance.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_citations

tools.description:
Full metadata for one paper: abstract, authors, venue, citations, PDFs.

`identifier`: a DOI (10.xxxx/..., doi.org URL), an arXiv ID or URL, an
OpenAlex work ID (W...), a Semantic Scholar paper ID (40 hex characters
or URL), or CorpusId:<n>. Combines OpenAlex with Semantic Scholar (TL;DR,
influential citations) and falls back to Crossref or arXiv.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_details

tools.description: Report which sources are configured and per-source request counters.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_search_health

tools.description:
Search Google Scholar (via Serper) for papers, with citation counts.

Broadest coverage, including books, theses, and publisher pages that
other indexes miss. Results include a publication line (authors, venue,
year), a snippet, "cited by" counts, and a PDF link when Scholar shows
one. Supports Google Scholar operators in `query`, e.g.
author:"Last Name", intitle:word, or "exact phrase". Each page holds up
to ten results (`num` trims the page); `page` continues. Each call is
billed by Serper; repeated identical calls within an hour are cached.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_scholar_search

tools.description:
Search several scholarly sources at once and merge the results.

Queries the sources in parallel, merges duplicates by DOI, arXiv ID, or
title, and ranks papers found by more sources and ranked higher first.
Each merged record lists the sources that returned it.

`sources`: any of google_scholar, openalex, semantic_scholar, crossref,
dblp, arxiv. Default: all of them (google_scholar only when Serper is
configured). DBLP matches every query word against titles, so short
keyword queries suit it best. Google Scholar year filters apply to the
returned page only. Per-source failures are reported in Notes rather
than failing the whole call. Cryptology ePrint papers are covered by
the ePrint tools as well as by DBLP, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_search_papers

tools.description:
Search Semantic Scholar (strong computer-science relevance ranking).

Filters: year range, venue (comma-separated names such as
"CRYPTO,EUROCRYPT"), and papers with an open-access PDF. Use
paper_details on a result for its TL;DR summary and reference counts.
tools.name: paper-search-mcp_semantic_scholar_search
